extraction.prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Isolate only the central full-length bearded apostle. Keep the thin original GOLD halo, blue under-robe, orange drapery, two hands, the small rolled WHITE SCROLL held in his hand, both original bare/sandalled feet. This is a scroll, not a book. Remove the distant gold field, red hanging wall cloth, all towers/architecture, painted turquoise ground and rectangular frame. No invented foot/anatomy. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

native_subject_size_evidence.method: Individually inspected native visible subject bounds, excluding input-region whitespace and neighbours.

review.notes: Compared native source region and white/dark renders. Entire original visible fingers/feet, table/basket/cauldron props, leaf and petal tips, stems and genuine openings checked. Source-provided floor retained only beneath the intrinsic cooking scene, never a gold/page rectangle.
